jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(H) inventory: Orange Southwest Unified Union Supervisory District -- the Orange Southwest School District, a unified union district that is its own supervisory district (member towns: Braintree, Brookfield, Randolph). The board also operates the Randolph Technical Career Center -- no separate CTE district here.

sources.note: Orange Southwest SD: eight directors, residency allocated Randolph 4 / Brookfield 2 / Braintree 2, elected by Australian ballot in all three towns on a single district warning (modified at-large, 16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2) pattern). No term ends are minted (see the flag in the sources). Orange Southwest SD board minutes, July 8, 2026 (official): "Board attending: Aimil Parmelee [Chair], Ryan Anderson, Anne Kaplan, Ray Zapata, Rachel Fish, Rachel Gaidys, Martha Hafner, Bev Lauchner." The March 11, 2026 minutes (first post-election meeting) seat the same eight with Zapata new and Sam Hooper gone; the January 15, 2026 warning is signed by the pre-election eight (incl. Hooper).

OSSD Warning 2026 (official legal notice, recorded with the district clerk January 15, 2026): Articles VII-VIII vote by Australian ballot in all three towns "One School Director from the residents of Randolph, Vt. for a term of three years" and "One School Director from the residents of Brookfield, Vt. for a term of three years" -- residency seats, district-wide vote (modified at-large). The board is 8 seats (Randolph 4, Brookfield 2, Braintree 2, the formation structure). FLAG: the district publishes no roster with towns or expirations; cohort expirations (2024 winners 2027, 2025 winners 2028, 2026 winners 2029) follow from the warnings but the winner pairings rest on newspaper reporting (lead) -- so NO ends are minted. The Lauchner/Zapata residency pairing (Zapata to Hooper's Brookfield seat, Lauchner re-elected to Randolph) is an inference, not used to split posts. Missing: the OSSD Articles of Agreement; the district clerk's certified March 3, 2026 returns.
